title: Evaluation of the Fundoplicature of the Excluded Stomach Post Omega Bypass
official: Evaluation of Post-Omega Bypass Excluded Stomach Fundoplication to Treat Disabling Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease Resistant to Medical Treatment and Requiring Surgery
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of fundoplication with stomach excluded in the suppression of disabling gastroesophageal reflux requiring surgery in patients who have undergone one anastomosis gastric bypass, with complete objective evaluation of reflux.

interventions.name: Bypass surgery type one anastomosis gastric bypass

sponsor: GCS Ramsay Santé pour l'Enseignement et la Recherche
